# Analysis

Read the required standards when producing figures, molecular views or slides.
Interpret validated results within their measured/predicted scopes. Keep ranked
tables, selections, plots, methods, provenance and reports in 04_analysis/.
Use stable design identities and exact source hashes. Include missing data and
unresolved issues. Validate visible exports and retain render/report commands.

Competition submissions use the project's challenge requirements and ranked CSV
template. Preserve candidate sequences and eligibility evidence; record researcher
review explicitly. Preparing a submission package does not submit it.
